# Bistro Ten — garden-to-plate café & wine bar in Beaufort, SC

> Bistro Ten is a garden-to-plate café and wine bar at 10B Market in the village of Habersham, Beaufort, South Carolina 29906, opened June 2021 by Brian and Melanie McCaffree. Lunch Tuesday–Saturday 11am–3pm, dinner Wednesday–Saturday 5–8pm; closed Sunday and Monday. Reservations on Resy. Phone 843-466-3661. Offers private events, off-site catering, wine dinners and cooking classes. Sister restaurant to Criollo next door (https://criollobeaufort.com).

## Key facts
- Address: 10B Market, Beaufort, SC 29906 (village of Habersham)
- Hours: Lunch Tue–Sat 11am–3pm; Dinner Wed–Sat 5pm–8pm; closed Sunday & Monday. Occasionally closed for private events (always posted).
- Reservations: https://resy.com/cities/beaufort-sc/venues/bistro-ten (tables of 2–6); larger groups call or use the enquiry form
- Phone: 843-466-3661 · Email: hello@bistroten.com
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/bistrotenonmarket/ · https://www.facebook.com/bistrotenonmarket
- Kitchen: head chef Charles Williams, sous chef Calvin Jenkins; special events by Chefs Sarah & Cody
- Garden-to-plate: herbs from the restaurant's own raised beds (kept by Brian McCaffree), greens from Hardee Greens in Hardeeville SC, oysters from Lady's Island Oysters, shrimp from local fishermen
- Seating: intimate dining room and a covered patio beside the garden beds; dogs welcome on the patio
- Every dinner dish is printed with a suggested white and red wine pairing; full wine list by the 7oz glass and bottle

## Private events
Graduations, bridal and baby showers, engagement parties, rehearsal dinners, birthdays, weddings and receptions — including full restaurant buy-outs and garden dinners. Ticketed wine dinners, oyster & wine tastings, cooking classes, Sunday Suppers and holiday brunches run through the year.

## Catering
Boards and grazing tables, family-style platters, seated plated dinners and brunch — at your home or venue, at Bistro Ten, or drop-off. For weddings, rehearsal dinners, showers, graduations, milestones, client dinners and board lunches around Beaufort and the Lowcountry. No fixed packages; every menu and quote is built per event from that week's produce.

## Sister restaurant
Criollo, 9 Market — Spanish & Latin American tapas and cocktails, dinner Tue–Sat, private events: https://criollobeaufort.com
